notes: Server: the engine's 'self-hosted-server' way (native systemd service via scripts/install-pi.sh, scripts/update.sh, owner-only Update server button); Docker was used first and removed. Deliberate differences: (1) the server is built (esbuild bundle apps/server/dist/server.mjs), so update.sh runs `pnpm build`, and the installer clones with tags (the version shown comes from `git describe`); (2) the first account is the owner (lowest user id, no is_admin column) and needs a setup code the installer sets; (3) NO cloudflare-access Settings fields in the web page: the web page is same-origin so the browser's Access cookie covers it; the Android app takes an optional service token on its own address screen, used only by the widget; (4) NO device-pairing code: the Android app shows the server's page in a WebView and the page hands a token to the widget through the bridge; (5) Android shell differs from the engine's android-shell: it loads the SERVER's page instead of a bundled copy at http://localhost (no version skew, no CORS), applicationId app.turbokeep.android, widget + quick add + share target instead of media playback, OkHttp for native calls. Standard Notes, Vikunja and TurboKeep bundle import/export live in apps/server/src/formats and io.ts. A task is a note with a task attached (schema v2).
